lessons.title: Files, Directories, Programs, and Processes
lessons.why: Here’s the simple reason this matters: This lesson is about Files, Directories, Programs, and Processes. Keep the idea practical: in local development: files, processes, the shell, the network, and the browser, the worked example should show that the shell shows your working directory, any Node process, and the new Node process prints its PID plus the directory it considers the current working directory. Once you can explain why that happens, the name is much easier to remember. We connect it to the course project so you can see the idea working instead of memorizing a definition.
